protocol.source_text: General  procedure  B  was  applied  to  7-bromo-2-methylquinoline  (222mg,  1.00mmol).  The  reaction  was stirred at room temperaturefor 48 hoursto afford a mixture of 2 monoborylated isomers in a 80:20ratio. Purification  by  silica  gel  flash-column  chromatography  with  gradient  elution  of  MeOH/DCM  from  0.5 -12.5%   over   25   column   volumes,   afforded   the   major   product,   (Rf0.1)   7-bromo-2-methyl-4-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-[1,3,2]dioxaborolan-2-yl)quinoline,  as  a  white  solid  (225  mg,  65%);  m.p.149 -150  °C; Further     elution     afforded     (Rf0.05)     7-bromo-2-methyl-5-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-[1,3,2]dioxaborolan-2-yl)quinoline a white solid (52 mg, 15%); m.p.151 -152 °C;
